mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate increases the risk-free rate and discount rate for equity valuation, reducing expected future cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% (50th percentile), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer spending that depresses corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime where industrial production growth is decelerating (INDPRO growth rate below 1.5% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion (INDPRO growth < 1.5% annually), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% per annum indicates a tightening monetary policy stance that raises the cost of capital and dampens economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 2000 thousand units indicates a contraction in the residential sector that reduces household wealth and business capital expenditure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market that depresses consumer confidence and corporate profit growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls from prior month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output and economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 110 (50th percentile), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
